answer: An admission auction stops fake identities. Each epoch offers 200 slots; applicants submit sealed bids, the clearing price is the fee, locked 20 epochs, and a violet badge marks a paid slot. Faking 1,000 identities at 50 credits each costs 50,000 credits, above one epoch's reward. Past bids stay visible like shale layers. A sudden ripple of identical bids triggers review and burns deposits. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
